tools.name: chandler_signals
tools.description: County-level workforce displacement signals (severity, score, forecast). Free preview masks county names.

tools.name: chandler_warn
tools.description: WARN Act layoff notices (company, workers affected, dates). Free preview masks company names.

tools.name: chandler_court_signals
tools.description: Bankruptcy / WARN-lawsuit / NLRB court filings (Chapter 11 etc.) as displacement events. PAID.

tools.name: chandler_economic_context
tools.description: ENTERPRISE: raw measured economic indicators behind each county — Census building permits (county), BLS QCEW industry employment (county x NAICS), and NY Fed household delinquency (STATE level). Included with Chandler Enterprise.

tools.name: chandler_commerce_signals
tools.description: Chandler Commerce Signals — county demand-intelligence for local service businesses. Free: one county name + risk tier + recent layoff worker count. Paid ($299/mo): full distress score, WARN filing details, 3/6-mo forecast, per-county signal window.

tools.name: deathcare_market
tools.description: Current-year expected deaths for a county or state — market size for death-care operators and investors. Free preview masks county names.

tools.name: deathcare_projection
tools.description: Year-by-year expected deaths for a county, 2025-2040. Shows the baby-boomer mortality trajectory. PAID (Professional and above).

tools.name: deathcare_growth_ranking
tools.description: Rank counties by projected growth in deaths 2025-2040 — the expansion/market-selection question. National percentile is computed across all 3,144 counties. PAID (Professional and above).

tools.name: deathcare_bulk_extract
tools.description: ENTERPRISE: bulk extract of the full projection series (all counties x 2025-2040) for a state, plus the underlying current-year baseline.

tools.name: browser_fetch
tools.description: Render a public web page in a real headless browser and return its title, visible text and links. JavaScript is executed, so it works on pages a plain HTTP fetch cannot read. Free preview returns the title and a short excerpt; paid returns full text and links.
